verdict.rationale: Choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for a cloud speech-to-text API, but the evidence pack never documents selecting a storage region. The marketing line "Deploy in the cloud or on-prem" describes a deployment model, not a region or residency choice. HIPAA-compliant processing is likewise a related but different compliance control, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
